messages.content: Hi, this is Northline Care's check-in. Your morning glucose was 289. Our nurse team is reviewing this today and will reach out to you shortly.
That high? What do I do??
Don't panic—the nurse will talk you through next steps. They can give clinical advice, I can't.
Can I adjust my insulin dose?
Please wait to talk to the nurse about that. Don't change your medications on your own.
Our median response time is currently 31 hours. You should hear from them by tomorrow or the day after. If you feel really unwell before then, call 911.
Good. I'm marking you for next week's check-in. Hang tight! 💙

theme: reading flagged high and escalated to a nurse
